test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2f6d3b104d0e9193679a529997c1de1b2758ed844410ebc89e5d0c92b8ec805.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: GT - EQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7c9ce68717d8fbc04891fd483d4e1fcaff3bd276d99169e78388d2463b319f0.png] 

Option 2: YO - WM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4adf3493b7ac55cfdfec430e5799cf18d3eb1e0d6c823911d145597d1541d5a1.png] 

Option 3: SW - QU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/266e0bed5feb7afb7cc84ed42cd86f3ee8d5ba00cea3846c88975855f078d95d.png] 

Option 4: XE - VC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10e45697c0c011d59c98ae8ddcf5c3b34d412e74d5fa3cdb74da051ad45dbc4d.png] 

Thus, GT - EQ does not follow the pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 1.**
